description: Encrypts all PII and sensitive fields in the outbound adapter payload using AES-256-GCM before transmitting over the network. Automatically applied to adapters that process identity data such as Aadhaar numbers, PAN cards, date of birth, and account numbers. Ensures that even if the TLS layer is compromised, payload data remains protected. The plaintext is never transmitted if encryption fails — the call is aborted. Required for DPDP Act 2023 compliance and RBI data-in-transit security standards for sensitive personal and financial data.
use_cases: Encrypting Aadhaar number before sending to Karza or DigiLocker
Protecting PAN card and date of birth in bureau API payloads
Field-level encryption for DPDP Act 2023 compliance
Securing bank account numbers in penny drop requests
Data-in-transit protection for identity and credit bureau adapters
when_to_use: Attach to all adapters that transmit PII (Aadhaar, PAN, DOB, bank account). Mandatory for KYC, bureau, and banking adapters.
trigger_condition: Before payload leaves the instance for adapters that require field-level encryption

input_parameters.description: List of field names to encrypt (from transformation rules)

output.on_success: Encrypted payload with sensitive fields replaced by ciphertext
output.on_failure: Call aborted; plaintext never transmitted; HOOK_001 logged
